lines.say: Land plants alternate between two multicellular stages.
The diploid sporophyte makes haploid spores by meiosis.
A spore grows by mitosis into the haploid gametophyte.
The gametophyte makes gametes by mitosis. It's already haploid.

draw.alt: Life cycle loop: sporophyte, spores, gametophyte, gametes, zygote

lines.say: Gametes fuse to make a diploid zygote, which grows into a new sporophyte.
Key point: in plants, meiosis makes spores, not gametes.
Moss is mostly gametophyte. It has no vascular tissue, so it stays small and damp.
Ferns have xylem and phloem, and a big sporophyte. Sperm still swim in water.
Gymnosperms use pollen and naked seeds. No free water needed.
Angiosperms add flowers and fruit. Across the groups, the gametophyte shrinks.

draw.alt: Gametophyte shrinking from moss to angiosperm

lines.say: Double fertilisation: one sperm makes the zygote, one makes triploid endosperm.
Plants are autotrophs. They make sugar by photosynthesis.
Root hairs absorb water and minerals. Transpiration pulls water up the xylem.
Nitrogen for proteins, phosphorus for ATP, magnesium for chlorophyll.
Rhizobium in legume nodules fixes nitrogen gas for the plant.
On phosphorus poor Australian soils, banksias use cluster roots.
Fungi are heterotrophs with chitin walls. They're closer to animals than plants.
The body is a mycelium of thin hyphae. The mushroom is only the reproductive part.

draw.alt: Mushroom above ground with large hidden mycelium below

lines.say: Fungi secrete enzymes outside, then absorb the small molecules.
Decomposers break down lignin. Parasites like chytrid harm frogs. Others are mutualists.
The cytoplasm marries first. That's plasmogamy.
The two nuclei stay separate for a while. The cell is dikaryotic, n plus n.

draw.alt: Two nuclei in one cell, then fused into one diploid nucleus

lines.say: Later the nuclei move in together. That's karyogamy, giving a diploid nucleus.
Meiosis then makes varied haploid spores. Asci in sac fungi, basidia in mushrooms.
In mycorrhizae, the plant gives sugar. The fungus gives water and phosphate.
Eucalypt seedlings with the fungus grew from 0.8 to 2 grams.
That's a 150 percent increase. Shoot phosphorus rose by 150 percent too.
Ectomycorrhizae wrap the root. Arbuscular ones go inside root cells.
Lichens are a fungus plus an alga or cyanobacterium. They're pioneer species.
Plants don't make gametes by meiosis. Gametes come from mitosis.
The green moss plant is the gametophyte, not the sporophyte.
Fungi are not plants. And the mushroom isn't the whole fungus.
